name: brick-breaker
tagline: Breakout in C++20 and raylib, with a boss fight.
summary: A neon-vector brick-breaker in modern C++ against raylib: a hand-built mecha boss, screen-shake-driven slow motion, a slide-levelling system that persists, an endless procedurally generated campaign, and doctest tests wired into CMake. The one project here in a language with neither a garbage collector nor a borrow checker.

swe.angle: C++20 and raylib: a procedurally generated campaign, a boss fight, doctest tests, and no runtime to hide behind.

highlights: Endless campaign generated procedurally from JSON level definitions, with a hand-built mecha boss.
Dependencies pulled by CMake FetchContent and tests in doctest, so a clean checkout builds and tests with two commands.
